comp-mrg0d7ri.html: Releasing music is a system, not a single day. This playbook covers what to do before, during, and after your release.

comp-mrg0d7rl1.html:
• Finalise master and metadata (ISRC, credits, genre tags)

  • Prepare artwork and short-form video teasers

  • Set up pre-save links and distributor timeline

  • Build a 2-week content calendar around the release story

comp-mrg3bjbc.html:
• Publish across platforms simultaneously

  • Share personal story behind the track — not just the link

  • Engage with every comment in the first 48 hours

  • Pin the release post and update bio links

comp-mrg3c6jq.html:
• Submit to playlists and community curators

  • Repurpose audio into reels, behind-the-scenes, and lyric snippets

  • Track saves, shares, and profile visits — not just stream count

  • Plan the next release while momentum is warm
